name: Weekly WFH Report
query:
SELECT
    employee_name,
    SUM(total_days) AS "total_days",
    GROUP_CONCAT(
        CASE
            WHEN from_date = to_date THEN DATE_FORMAT(from_date, '%%d %%b %%Y')
            ELSE CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(from_date, '%%d %%b %%Y'), ' - ', DATE_FORMAT(to_date, '%%d %%b %%Y'))
        END
        ORDER BY from_date
        SEPARATOR ', '
    ) AS wfh_date_ranges
FROM
    `tabWork From Home`
WHERE
    status = "Approved"
    AND docstatus = 1
    AND from_date BETWEEN
        DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 7 DAY)
        AND
        DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 1 DAY)
GROUP BY
    employee,
    employee_name
ORDER BY
    employee_name ASC;
